cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a quiet guesthouse breakfast nook beside an open courtyard — tasting warm rice pudding from a small spoon after an early swim; an open pavilion floating above a sea of clouds at sunrise — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a quiet campsite with a small tent and a cooking kit — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a neighborhood bakery window seat at early morning opening time — sharing the quiet ritual of breaking a warm roll for her own breakfast; the paved square before a city gate tower — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a Peking opera dressing room — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; an alchemist's potion workshop — standing close to a high shelf or line; her bedroom — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a circus tent ring under a striped canopy — standing; a clear spring glowing with soft blue light in a mossy grotto — standing with one foot up on a step; her bedroom — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a training gym with a heavy bag — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a Three Kingdoms festival street — carries her keepsake low at her side
